declienting: Removed the Sitecore Content SDK link handling, the LinkField prop, and helpers/sitecore-link; navigation now uses the library Link while Button remains a native button.
Removed next/link and the temporary polymorphic `as`/`href` seam, so framework routing remains consumer-owned without making Button Next-only.
Replaced the colour-scheme context with an explicit surface (light/dark) prop, which keeps the palette choice serializable across a server boundary.
Cut four variants to three: secondaryOutline collapsed into secondary, and the accent variant was dropped because it existed only to carry the client's brand red.
Mapped every --sem-button-* and --color-brand-* token onto neutral control-* semantic tokens.
Narrowed the polymorphic control to a native button, so native type and disabled semantics no longer require an element-type guard.
Kept verbatim: the icon slots and disabled styling; the server-first rewrite made surface explicit and moved navigation to Link.
